name: XRechnung & ZUGFeRD / Factur-X Parser

name: ECB Exchange Rates
description: Converts invoice amounts between currencies with the official ECB euro reference rates for each invoice date; weekend and holiday fallbacks are flagged with the rate date actually used.

name: BaFin Warnings Scraper

name: DefiLlama Data Export

name: German Public Tenders Scraper
description: Searches German public tenders on service.bund.de by keyword, federal state, category and date, with authority, CPV and deadline.

name: DACH Shop Company Profiler

name: Competitor Website Monitor

name: Shipping & Returns Policy Extractor

name: German Apprenticeships

name: PDF Toolkit API
